_comment: The np binary Jott ships inside its installer. Pinned by version AND hash: `scripts/fetch-np` refuses an asset whose sha256 differs, so a tampered or half-downloaded release fails the build instead of becoming somebody's note index. Bump all fields together; the hashes are the ones in that release's own SHA256SUMS.txt (verified here with `sha256sum -c` against the downloaded asset, not copied from a page).
